title: Conditional κ ≥ 0.0037194530062 (+0.06374% over #7660) with full-extent private banks
body:
This construction gives **conditional κ ≥ 0.0037194530062**. It adds **0.0000023694495 (0.06374%)** over the strongest open bound I found. It also supplies an exact-arithmetic, full-private-extent implementation for the changed word using fresh finite physical costs under the five selected framework assumptions. The resulting bound is **2.46263% above the selected 0.00363005817**. Most of that difference was already present numerically in the open parent. [Proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b81f40997de646de30749d367484d89e59fc3013/research/p104-joint-chart-banks/PROOF.md) · [Full signed receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b81f40997de646de30749d367484d89e59fc3013/research/p104-joint-chart-banks/RESULT.json) · [Parent construction, PR #7660](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7660) · [Selected application](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57/docs/research/pr-intake-evidence/pr7000-application/PROOF-REVIEW.md)

## What changed

Fifteen scalar contacts use a common hyperplane restriction and eighteen use a common line extension. Six helper endpoints change. Four paid positions disappear per native invocation. Across the actual 17-call signed caller, the paid count falls from 108,581 to **108,513**, with 22,461 independent productive fields and rank-mass surplus 1,424. Both paid **and** target rank distributions change. Two directed evaluators place the raw crossing between **0.00371945300635 and 0.00371945300636**. The interior probe passes the 54 strict and four functional outer conditions. [Literal edit](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b81f40997de646de30749d367484d89e59fc3013/research/p104-joint-chart-banks/EDIT.json) · [Source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b81f40997de646de30749d367484d89e59fc3013/research/p104-joint-chart-banks/SOURCE-PINS.json)

Each of the 3,978 native lifetimes across the signed caller receives its own full physical home. An extent guide generated from the geometry drives a complete overwrite in 2L+3 local transitions for L cells, including dirty or blank interior cells. A common-grid induction establishes exact signed division after every completed child in this implementation. The five remaining assumptions cover native all-column adapters, owned allocation, compiler closure, fixed-tape movement and storage, and analytic recovery. The historical supplier for arbitrary rounded residuals at one fixed tariff remains open. [Extent and scalar implementation](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b81f40997de646de30749d367484d89e59fc3013/research/p104-joint-chart-banks/banks.py) · [Prior typed initialization, PR #7586](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7586) · [Rounded parent-clock alternative, PR #7662](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7662)

## Verification

Run from the repository root with CPython 3.12 and its standard library.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-joint-chart-banks
```

Expected markers include

```text
PASS_JOINT_NATIVE 1501 234 [100502, 187, True]
PASS_JOINT_APPLICATION 0.0037194530062 108513 22461
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/p104-joint-chart-banks outcome=completed
```

The registered replay passed locally and on Ubuntu 24.04 with CPython 3.12. The [hosted scientific job](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44238210256/job/134581087948) reproduced the signed κ and all six catalogue shards. It checked every public row, all 234 ordered erasure identities, 3,023 native operators, and 104 main boundary pairs. It explicitly compared 512 forward and 512 adjoint columns on each of the 18 new chart pairs. Controls rejected a phase-only fault, an equal-price scalar sign error, an aliased stage, a self-referential erasure witness and an odd-tick exact division. A literal full multiplier execution and independent human review remain open. [Registered checks](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b81f40997de646de30749d367484d89e59fc3013/research/p104-joint-chart-banks/VERIFY.json)
